probes.name: insert_above
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, cell As Range, n As Long
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
ws.Range("B2").Formula2 = "=SEQUENCE(3,2)"
Application.Calculate
On Error Resume Next
ws.Rows(1).Insert
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Application.Calculate
Probe = CStr(n)
For Each cell In ws.Range("A1:F6")
Probe = Probe & "|" & cell.Address(False,False) & ":" & CStr(cell.Value2) & ":" & cell.Formula2 & ":" & cell.HasSpill
Next
End Function

probes.name: sort_object
probes.macro:
Function Probe() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet, cell As Range, n As Long
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
ws.Range("B2").Formula2 = "=SEQUENCE(3,2)"
Application.Calculate
On Error Resume Next
ws.Sort.SortFields.Clear
ws.Sort.SortFields.Add Key:=ws.Range("B2"), Order:=xlDescending
ws.Sort.SetRange ws.Range("B2:C4")
ws.Sort.Header = xlNo
ws.Sort.Apply
n = Err.Number
On Error GoTo 0
Application.Calculate
Probe = CStr(n)
For Each cell In ws.Range("A1:F6")

End Function
